assertions.text: retain for at least four (4) years
assertions.note: sources state no less than four years

assertions.text: pay by stated date, or within thirty (30) days of completion

gaps: The $250 threshold aggregates across all contracts between the same hiring party and contractor in the preceding 120 days. The clause states a flat $250 and would let a user split engagements below the threshold and believe they were outside the Act.
The hiring party must furnish a signed copy of the contract to the freelance worker. The clause requires a written contract but not that a signed copy be provided.
